gomod.description: Run `go mod tidy` after every Go update. Without it Renovate records only the /go.mod hashes for a bumped version, so go.sum ends up missing the module-zip (h1:) hashes and keeps superseded entries. Tool-only modules break outright, because `go install` runs in -mod=readonly.

packageRules.description: Fleet's migrations and generated columns compute checksums with MySQL's MD5(), which MySQL removed in the 26.x line. Upstream Fleet tests only 8.0.44/8.4.8/9.5.0 and documents 9.6.0 as incompatible, so CI stays on the 8.4 LTS.
